description: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines conformance level most laws and policies reference.
Using elements for their meaning (`button`, `a`, `nav`, `label`, headings) so roles and keyboard behavior come for free.
Attributes (`role`, `aria-*`) that describe semantics and state to assistive tech. They never add behavior.
In a composite widget only the active item has `tabIndex={0}`; the others have `-1` and are reached with arrow keys.
Moving focus deliberately when UI changes: into dialogs, back to triggers, to the new page heading after navigation.
`role="status"` or `role="alert"` containers whose updates screen readers announce without moving focus.
